maintainer: Pour les analogue c'est pire ! Tu as rogner sur les deux analogue et quand je les bouges ont remarque les défauts !!!
je veux le cercle entier de chaque analogue est qu'il soit homogène ! comme tu as pu le faire avec la PS2 ou la Wii. Reprends de Zéro si tu pense qu'il vaut mieux repartir sur une base saine.

rejected.PR157 (IPA 650): a 1.12 x hand-radius disc around a hand centre: wider than the cap, it took socket and gate texture with it
rejected.PR160 (IPA 657): the light face circle only: the bevel, side wall and the C-stick's darker yellow ring stayed behind (device-0155-*.png)
rejected.PR161 (not integrated, closed): a face + side wall stadium: its top was measured 7-9 px too high (into the socket) and the shape was not a circle

finding: measure_stick_caps.py, 180 rays per stick, outermost edge where the cap meets its socket or gate: every GameCube/Wii cap, side wall and the C-stick's yellow ring included, is a circle (semi-axes within 1 %, p90 residual 0.15-0.23 px, 180/180 rays kept). The whole round stick is therefore one circle that can move without cropping or dragging anything.
fix: from current Claude (not from PR161): each GameCube/Wii stick declares its measured whole cap (centre, radius); the knob is that circle (+0.4 px edge), cut at whole upscaled pixels with an even diameter so knob, declared size and frame share one centre; the socket under it is refilled 1.2 px wider by a harmonic fill from the socket or gate all round (one homogeneous floor, no disc edge, no streak, no cap colour left), a little darker toward the middle; square frame, travel = half - radius as before. PS2 Original byte-identical (it already moved its whole dome).
homogeneity: homogeneity-before-after.json (before = PR #160 on the device): cap left behind 5.7-33.7 % -> 0 %; socket texture inside the moving piece up to 8.1 % -> at most 0.2 % (its antialiased edge); cap colour left in the socket under the C-stick 100 % -> 0 %
audit: audit-before-after.json: misrouted 0 %; moving cap centre 4.6-8.5 pt from the whole cap before, 0.09-0.17 pt after; travel 9.1-11.4 pt (7.3-11.0 before)
